concurrency.rationale: Serial execution in sealed executionOrder = perfectly equal cell exposure (C5 concurrencyMustBeFrozenAndEqualAcrossCells satisfied trivially); a Max-plan capacity event lands on a randomized-order sample, never systematically on one cell. The conductor is invoked with maxParallel=1 (its default is 2; the sealed value governs).

interleaving.mechanism: sealed SampleScheduleV1: deterministic seeded shuffle (mulberry32/fnv1a over the sealed randomizationSeed), blocked by (bookId, chapterNumber) with every cell represented inside each block; executionOrder is a total order the serial worker follows exactly
interleaving.balanced: by construction — no cell can lead or trail systematically; schedule bytes are hashed into the seal and re-verified before every guarded phase

retryAndReplay.writer: exactly 1 attempt per sample (firstWriteOnly); <=1 infrastructure replay per sample, SAME blindSampleId, only for {infrastructure_failure, timeout, provider_rate_or_capacity}; NEVER for content_invalid or provider_safeguard_or_refusal; the original outcome + redacted spawn tail are retained on the record and in evidence
retryAndReplay.reviewPhase2: <=2 in-instrument adjudicator attempts (authorReview.ts:977); failure -> typed 'unavailable' on an advisory instrument, never a verdict
retryAndReplay.stageQ: <=2 attempts per (case x judge) in both qualification layers
retryAndReplay.hiddenReplay: none exists: a replay is a recorded field (outcome.replayed + originalProviderOutcome), never a substitution

planCapacityInterruption.classification: provider_rate_or_capacity — a DISTINCT recorded outcome, reported separately from content defects, safeguards, and infrastructure failures
planCapacityInterruption.shortInterruption: the <=1 bounded replay may absorb a transient capacity event; if the replay also fails, the sample stands as capacity-terminal — retained, never discarded, never rerun
planCapacityInterruption.longInterruption: operator stops the run; the durable manifest + per-sample records make resume idempotent: completed samples are SKIPPED (no re-calls), incomplete ones resume under the SAME sealed schedule and blindSampleIds; the interruption boundary is visible in record timestamps and is reported
planCapacityInterruption.fairness: capacity events are counted per cell by the sealed owner-policy evaluator; materially unequal, unbalanceable exposure => operational comparison INCONCLUSIVE (C5.quotaOrRateLimitHandling.differentialExposureThatCannotBeBalanced)

adjudicationPause.point: conductor runs through=analyze and STOPS before unblind
adjudicationPause.steps: blind adjudication packet built per C3 blindness list -> owner completes ALL required cases -> completed human-adjudication.json placed in the experiment root and hashed -> unblind -> decide -> report
adjudicationPause.enforcement: zero-tolerance threshold groups evaluate INCONCLUSIVE (never pass) without the completed file; unblind independently refuses if metric tables or the thresholds copy drifted from the seal

noOutputInformedChanges: the stopping decision is evaluated ONCE on interim screening metrics and persisted; thresholds/spec/schedule/stack hashes are sealed; unblind hash-gates; post-live-output changes to any endpoint, threshold, or stopping rule are barred (owner C4/C5 decisionPolicy + seal mechanics)

executionRoute.authorizedRoute: codex exec authenticated by ChatGPT-subscription OAuth — the ONLY model route for every §16 model-bearing operation (Stage-Q reads, authoring, reviews, judge panel, replays)
executionRoute.broker: spawnCodexAgent (src/orchestrator/codexAgent.ts) — every §16 spawn site resolves to it via AutopilotDeps.spawn or direct import; roles declared at every site
executionRoute.failClosed: buildIsolatedSession(requireAuth) asserts the COPIED auth.json proves auth_mode="chatgpt", no usable OPENAI_API_KEY, OAuth tokens present — ExecPreflightError BEFORE any process otherwise (commit d6f25f1c8); forbidden provider env (OPENAI_API_KEY, CODEX_API_KEY, base-URL overrides, Azure/Anthropic) refused at the caller-env seam and absent from the allowlist
executionRoute.perAttemptTelemetry: every spawn writes a RouteResultV1 v2 sidecar recording executionRoute=codex_exec_chatgpt_subscription, authMode=chatgpt, apiKeyPresent=false, apiFallbackAllowed=false (+ outcome, model, effort, drift fingerprint) beside its effective-context manifest in logs/exec/
executionRoute.noFallback: no API-provider fallback branch exists; provider_rate_or_capacity is a recorded outcome eligible only for the sealed <=1 bounded replay on the same route
executionRoute.conductorProcessEnv: the live run-driver asserts, before the first spawn: no OPENAI_API_KEY/CODEX_API_KEY/OPENAI_BASE_URL/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in its own environment, and CHAPTERFLOW_NO_API_CODEX_QC=1 set
executionRoute.secretHygiene: auth.json contents never appear in reports/manifests/seals/logs/commits; per-spawn copies are 0700-dir/0600-file in tmpdir OUTSIDE the repository and are deleted in finally (stale-sweep crash net)

stageQSequencing.order: Layer O (owner 64-case instrument, C4 bounds incl. pairwise kappa) runs FIRST; any panel judge failing Layer O HALTS the campaign before any Layer-N or candidate call — judge substitution is a protocol change and is NOT authorized
stageQSequencing.conjunction: a judge is qualified ONLY as (Layer-O pass ∧ Layer-N pass on the owner-approved corpus a127d8ce93a2473a8c0cf3a7388056e97ee7df85056aa23561db0576630b6498 (ownerApprovedForDevelopmentBakeoff: true; independentHumanRater: false)); enforced by sequencing + the owner-policy evaluator stageQ verdicts (fail-closed on missing evidence)
stageQSequencing.seedFixtures: the 3 SEED-* Layer-N compatibility fixtures are sealed in stage-q/seed-fixtures.sealed.json (sha 3a952e0ede7b2f0c99195fc60cf8a861754532e4977cb3c97ca5e4cc4e561ca7) under the owner B1 conditional approval; they can never rescue a Layer-O failure and are not an independent human rating
